# iBluSend

Connect one iBluSend workspace to read conversations, contacts, devices, groups, delivery, opt-out and bot status, and send one confirmed message at a time. Areas the person ticks add reports, templates, campaigns, the calendar and invoices (drafts only; nothing launches or charges), plus contact edits, iMessage extras and calendar booking under Read and act, only for contacts the person approves.

## Connection

This plugin connects to `https://api.iblusend.com/functions/v1/agent-api/v1/mcp/public` using the host's remote HTTP MCP support.
OAuth discovery is server-driven. Do not add an API key, access token, client secret, or static
Authorization header to this package.

## Included workflows

- `inbox-triage`: read-only review and action list.
- `safe-draft-and-send`: exact preview, explicit confirmation, one send, status check.
- `contact-device-compliance`: inspect one contact/device or confirm one opt-out/bot change.
- `reports`: read the Reports page numbers.
- `templates`: read message templates and save a template the person approves.
- `campaigns`: read campaigns and save a draft the person launches in the app.
- `calendar`: read appointments and open times, and prepare booking links the person confirms.
- `invoices`: read invoices and what is owed, and save a draft the person sends in the app.
- `contact-edits`: add or edit one contact; tags and custom fields only on approved contacts.
- `imessage-extras`: tapbacks, typing bubbles, read receipts and voice memos to approved contacts.
- `calendar-booking`: book, move or cancel an appointment in chat after a preview and a yes.
- `workflow-builder`: build and edit workflow drafts the owner publishes in the app.
- `bot-builder`: build, edit and teach chat bots; new bots start off and go on only after the owner's yes to a preview.
- `voice-agents`: propose a voice agent prompt or greeting the owner applies in Voice Studio.
- `past-texts`: read the past texts the owner copied from their Mac.

## Messaging tools

The connection is bound to one workspace per consent grant. Every OAuth grant discovers the same
thirteen messaging tools. A Read-only grant can use the ten read tools; the three action tools return
an `insufficient_scope` challenge before validation or dispatch. Read and act authorizes those
actions, which still require host confirmation. Public OAuth sends are 1:1 only; group conversations
remain readable. This plugin is not a bulk sender.

## Optional areas

On the Connect screen the person can also tick optional areas. Nothing is ticked for them. Each
area is its own OAuth scope; a draft or act scope comes only with Read and act.

| Area | Read scope | Draft or act scope | Tools |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reports | `reports:read` | none | `get_report` |
| Templates | `templates:read` | `templates:drafts:write` | `list_templates`, `get_template`, `create_template`, `update_template` |
| Campaigns | `campaigns:read` | `campaigns:drafts:write` | `list_campaigns`, `get_campaign`, `list_campaign_audiences`, `create_campaign_draft`, `update_campaign_draft` |
| Calendar | `calendar:read` | none | `list_appointments`, `get_appointment`, `get_availability`, `list_meeting_types`, `draft_booking`, `draft_appointment_change` |
| Invoices | `invoices:read` | `invoices:drafts:write` | `list_invoices`, `get_invoice`, `create_invoice_draft`, `update_invoice_draft` |
| Contact edits | none | `contact_edits:write` | `create_contact`, `update_contact` |
| iMessage extras | none | `signals:write` | `send_reaction`, `remove_reaction`, `send_typing_indicator`, `mark_read`, `send_voice_memo` |
| Calendar booking | none | `bookings:write` | `book_appointment`, `change_appointment` |

Every grant discovers these twenty-nine area tools. A call without its area returns
`insufficient_scope`; the person reconnects and ticks that area. Connections made earlier keep
what they granted. Nothing in the reports, templates, campaigns, calendar or invoices areas sends,
launches, books or charges: a campaign launches only when the person presses Launch in the app, a
booking link waits for Schedule or Save, and an invoice waits for Send.

Contact edits, iMessage extras and calendar booking act. Each needs Read and act, and anything that
reaches a contact works only for contacts the person approved under Manage actions in the app,
never a group. A voice memo, a booking, a move and a cancel each wait for the person's yes to an
exact preview; a booking takes a second call with the preview's confirm code.

## Builder areas

Only the workspace owner can tick these, and only while the feature is on for the workspace. Their
tools appear only on a connection that ticked the area. A team member's connection never has them.

| Area | Read scope | Draft or act scope | Tools |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workflows | `workflows:read` | `workflows:drafts:write` | `list_workflow_blocks`, `get_workflow_block_schema`, `list_workflow_resources`, `list_workflows`, `get_workflow`, `validate_workflow_draft`, `create_workflow_draft`, `update_workflow_draft` |
| BluBot | `bots:read` | `bots:drafts:write` | `list_bot_templates`, `list_bots`, `get_bot`, `list_bot_knowledge`, `create_bot_draft`, `update_bot_draft`, `add_bot_knowledge`, `remove_bot_knowledge` |
| Switch bots on and off (with BluBot) | none | `bot_live:write` | `turn_bot_on`, `turn_bot_off` |
| Voice agents | `voice:read` | `voice:drafts:write` | `list_voice_agents`, `get_voice_agent`, `propose_voice_agent_change` |
| Past texts from your Mac | `history:read` | none | `list_history`, `search_history` |

Saving in a builder area changes a draft only. A workflow waits for Publish in the workflow builder,
and a voice agent proposal waits for Apply in Voice Studio. A bot is created switched off. It goes
on when the owner switches it on in the app, or, on a connection that also ticked Switch bots on and
off (Read and act only), after the owner says yes to a switch-on preview in a later turn: the AI
never switches a bot on by itself. Past texts only read.
